domainsMonitor.anomalyReasonEn: Domains Monitor reports an increase of 752,672 domains (+132.0%) compared to the previous snapshot. The cause of this jump is currently not independently verified. Possibilities include changes in scan coverage, a data backfill, a methodology change, or an actual mass rollout. rfc10023.de therefore does not currently interpret this jump as verified organic adoption growth.
